scope: Text and XML inspection only; no MAT/Parquet reads or numerical jobs. This is not a per-subject scaled-model validation.

findings.observed: Processing selects gait2392_simbody.osim. The model includes pelvis and hip rotations about multiple axes and ankle rotation axes right[-0.10501355,-0.17402245,0.97912632], left[0.10501355,0.17402245,0.97912632]. Adapter publishes thigh=pelvis+hip, shank=thigh-knee, foot=shank+ankle; the numerical audit repeats these expressions. Canonical definitions describe segment orientations in space.
findings.inference: Scalar sums are planar approximations, not demonstrated true segment orientations in this 3D model. Matching those expressions only establishes arithmetic/source-clock consistency.
limitations: No exact anatomical sign or neutral orientation is inferred solely from coordinate names
Template selection does not establish every actual scaled model or exported coordinate state

findings.observed: All four parsers take ForceN from the external-load prefix plus y, so ForceN is source Y force, not force-vector magnitude.
limitations: Configuration rules do not by themselves bind each normalized block to the actual source force file
Stair force reassignment and coordinate calibration still require file-level lineage review

findings.observed: Treadmill contact threshold uses 3% of maximum right force for both sides, and strfind returns the pre-crossing index. Raw detections within 20 samples of previous kept event are removed. Adjacent cycles are then filtered by force peak and late-cycle loading criteria.
limitations: Normalized-block completeness does not independently reconcile all original detections and excluded cycles
Force criteria are source processing rules, not independently validated physical heel-contact ground truth
